# Blygger Studio 0.46.1

*Released 2026-10-13, the reference client. [v0.46.1 on GitHub](https://github.com/blygger/blygger-studio/releases/tag/v0.46.1).*

**Migrations: none.** No config change.

- **Publishing shows at once on public pages.** Since 0.39.0 the edge cache
  kept serving a page's old copy for up to a minute after a publish, a
  withdrawal or a settings change, and a reload could not get past it. The
  cache key now carries the blyg's public revision (the `change_state`
  counters for items, subscriptions, hoppers, settings and feed), so the
  first read after a change goes to a fresh entry. Each public read costs one
  small D1 query. The owner's reading state and thumbs do not move the key.
  Hiding or showing an inbound mention still waits out the 60-second window:
  mentions have no revision counter yet.



*This announcement is drafted from the release's section of [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/blygger/blygger-studio/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md), which is where it is maintained. To comment, respond to this item from your own blyg.*

Blygger Studio 0.46.1

Released 2026-10-13, the reference client. v0.46.1 on GitHub.

Migrations: none. No config change.

  • Publishing shows at once on public pages. Since 0.39.0 the edge cache kept serving a page's old copy for up to a minute after a publish, a withdrawal or a settings change, and a reload could not get past it. The cache key now carries the blyg's public revision (the change_state counters for items, subscriptions, hoppers, settings and feed), so the first read after a change goes to a fresh entry. Each public read costs one small D1 query. The owner's reading state and thumbs do not move the key. Hiding or showing an inbound mention still waits out the 60-second window: mentions have no revision counter yet.
